name: Afrobeat call and response
desc: Bright afrobeat/highlife call-and-response chant: a syncopated dirt-samples speech backbone (the leader's call, sped up bright) answered by shabda female shout words (sunrise / electric / paradise) as the communal response. Sparse trades one call and answer; full pushes an off-beat 8-slot chant with an octave-echo double and every-4 lift; peak doubles up with jux-reversed calls and a lastOf reverse turnaround. Groove holds if the shabda voice drops out.

code.full: stack(s("[speech:1 ~ speech:4 ~ ~ speech:2 ~ speech:6]").speed("<1.1 1.05 1.15>").shape(.4).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.speed(1.5).gain(${gain}*.4)), s("[~ ~ sunrise ~ ~ ~ electric ~]").speed("<1.05 1.1>").shape(.35).lpf(${cut}*1.1).gain(${gain}*.55)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.35).delay(.3).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.4).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[speech:1 speech:4 ~ speech:2 speech:6 ~ speech:1 speech:4]*2").speed("<1.1 1.05 1.15 1.2>").shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.speed(1.5).gain(${gain}*.4)).jux(rev), s("[~ sunrise ~ electric ~ paradise ~ sunrise]").speed("<1.05 1.1 1.15>").shape(.4).lpf(${cut}*1.2).gain(${gain}*.55)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(8)).every(2, x=>x.fast(2)).lastOf(8, rev).room(.35).delay(.3).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.45).orbit(8).play()
